split_policy: official IDRiD 103-image test preserved; stratified 90/10 train/val carve of official train (seed 42)
preprocessing: OFFLINE rebuild: official IDRiD grading split (103-image test preserved); stratified 90/10 train/val carve (seed 42); three-tier ROI crop -> resize 224 -> CLAHE (LAB-L, clip 2.0, 8x8) on ALL splits -> geometric augmentation TRAIN ONLY (floor 60% of majority, cap 4x, rotation <=12deg, zoom 0.92-1.08, BORDER_REFLECT_101). Normalisation applied on-the-fly.
variance_note: seeds draw different subsets — std is meaningful
sanity_criterion: mean |rho| across fractions (more stable than a single full-randomization cutoff)
plausibility_note: IDRiD Segmentation subset (n=81), union of MA/HE/EX/SE, optic disc excluded. VERIFIED disjoint from the grading subset (different photographs: zero MD5 matches, perceptual corr 0.73-0.97). Inference only — never trained on.
honesty_flags: Report 371 UNIQUE training retinas, not the augmented total.
Class 1 support is 5 in test / 2 in val — per-class metrics are high-variance; early stopping keyed on overall val QWK.
Attention-Rollout is ViT-only; Swin uses a labelled TokenNorm surrogate. Never conflate them in tables.
Plausibility uses the IDRiD segmentation subset (n=81), verified DISJOINT from the grading images. APTOS has no masks — plausibility is IDRiD-only, and that asymmetry must be stated.
CLAHE applied to all splits as a fixed constant across explainers, so preprocessing is not a confound between methods.
